name: Procompsognathus
sum: Small coelophysid known from a poorly preserved skeleton from the Late Triassic of Germany, about 1 m long.
wsnote: Up to about 1 m according to Wikipedia revision 1361802594.
holotype: Not given in the sources used.
material: A fragmentary and poorly preserved skeleton.
biology: A small, lightly built, ground-dwelling, bipedal carnivore.
author: Fraas 1913

sources.text: E. Fraas. 1913. Die neuesten Dinosaurierfunde in der schwäbischen Trias [The newest dinosaur finds in the Swabian Trias]. Naturwissenschaften 1(45):1097-1100
